messages:
emily: Heads-up — planning to publish Py/TS SDK v2.0 tomorrow during the 10:00-11:00am PT change window. This will deprecate the legacy sync clients. Need signoffs on publish steps, pinning guidance, rollback plan, and docs/support copy.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: py/ts-sdk v2.0 publish set for 2026-07-15 17:00 UTC - 18:00 UTC. CI: ✅ green. @raj please ack.

raj: Ack. Staggered rollout: canary -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% over ~30m. Monitor errors and latency. Rollback trigger: errors > 5% in any region for 10m. I'll watch metrics and logs.

kate: Publish steps (internal):
```bash
# TS canary
npm publish dist/ts --tag canary
# Py build + canary (we use twine to a private index then promote)
python -m build && twine upload dist/* --repository pypi --verbose
```
We'll publish under `canary` first and retag to `latest` after smoke pass.

nina: QA will run compatibility smoke during canary. Tests: import, basic generate, streaming, kv-cache behavior. We'll also run our migration sample app. If we see deprecation warnings, confirm docs surfaced. ETA: ready by EOD.

jose: Support prepping canned responses for customers pinned to the sync client. Recommend advising pin to the latest 1.x: `redwood-sdk==1.9.3` and include migration snippet. I'll draft the article + Slack snippet.

tom: I'll update release notes + deprecation guide. Will include migration examples for TS and Py and call out the transport-layer breaking change. Also will add a small snippet about recommended pinning.

kate: Pinning guidance for release notes:
- npm: `npm i @redwood/sdk@^1.9.3`
- pip: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.9.3`
Add both to the top of the deprecation section.

emily: Rollback triggers (for clarity): 1) >5% 5xx errors sustained for 10m, 2) incompatible major client errors >1%, 3) SRE flags a regression in routing/latency. If triggered: stop promotion, retag `canary` -> `1.x` as needed, and publish a patch 1.9.4 if we need to restore behavior quickly. No mass unpublishes unless legal/PII.

raj: Rollback procedure: untag canary, promote 1.9.4 to `latest` (if already prepared), clear CDN caches for docs and download endpoints, disable automatic promotion jobs. I'll own the infra coordination.

deploy-bot: Reminder: change window enforcement active for that period. No other releases scheduled in the same window. CI logs & artifacts: https://ci.internal/reports/py-ts-sdk/1789

nina: :thumbsup: QA will post pass/fail here with smoke-run ID. Current QA run: 4521.

emily: Thanks all. @tom @jose make sure docs & support copy are staged and approved in the doc repo. I'll post a final pre-release checklist 15m before the window.
